get_font.description: Get one font on Fontsource: its category, subsets, weights, styles, licence, versions and where it comes from, with the npm install command and import line (static and variable), its CDN stylesheet as a link and an HTML tag, and the CSS that sets it.
get_font.name: get_font

parameters.description: The font. Pick it from the list, or type its family name (Open Sans) or its Fontsource id (open-sans).
parameters.name: font

category.description: Its style: sans-serif, serif, display, handwriting, monospace, icons or other.

default_subset.description: The subset its default stylesheet loads, usually latin.

family.description: The font's family name, such as 'Open Sans'.

file_count.description: How many font files it has in each format: one per weight, style and subset.

font_family_css.description: The CSS that sets the font, with a generic fallback, such as font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;

font_id.description: The font's Fontsource id, such as 'open-sans': what every Font field takes.

font_type.description: 'google' for a Google Font, 'other' for another open source font Fontsource packages.

import_statement.description: The line that loads it in a JavaScript app, at its default weight.

install_command.description: The command that installs its static package, such as npm install @fontsource/inter.

last_modified.description: When the font itself last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD: the date the 'Font updated' trigger watches.

license.description: Its licence, such as OFL-1.1 (SIL Open Font License) or Apache-2.0.

link_tag.description: An HTML <link> tag for that stylesheet, ready to paste into a page's <head>.

npm_package.description: Its npm package of static fonts, such as @fontsource/inter.

page_url.description: Its page on fontsource.org, with a preview and install steps.

source_url.description: Where Fontsource takes the font from, such as https://github.com/google/fonts.

styles.description: Its styles: normal, italic or both.

stylesheet_url.description: Its default stylesheet on Fontsource's CDN (jsDelivr), pinned to this release: its default weight (400 for most fonts), every subset.

variable.description: True when it also comes as a variable font, with every weight (and any other axes) in one file.

variable_import_statement.description: The line that loads its variable font. Empty when it is not variable.

variable_install_command.description: The command that installs its variable package. Empty when it is not variable.

variable_npm_package.description: Its npm package of the variable font, such as @fontsource-variable/inter. Empty when it is not variable.

version.description: The version of the font files from their source, such as 'v20' for a Google Font.

weights.description: The weights it comes in, from 100 (thin) to 900 (black).

description: Find and use open source fonts from Fontsource, the registry of more than 2,000 self-hostable fonts, every Google Font among them. Search fonts by name, category, language, weight and style, get a font's npm install command and CDN link, get ready-to-paste @font-face CSS and direct WOFF2 links for the weights you need, read a variable font's axes, and see download counts and releases. Start a workflow when a font is added or updated. No account or API key required.
